text: elena-customer: Hey, hitting a weird failure when generating debug bundle from our private deploy collector. collector exits after 3rd chunk with 403 on presigned upload. Request-id header from our side: rq_7fc2b1a3. maria-support: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact collector command you used and a short log snippet? also which collector version? elena-customer: Using the packaged collector v2.4.1 that came with our on-prem bundle. Command was: `./collector --generate-debug-bundle --env prod --upload presign` elena-customer: Log excerpt: ``` 2026-03-10T14:22:11Z INFO start bundle generation id=bundle-20260310-01 2026-03-10T14:22:18Z INFO chunk=1 size=4.2MB 2026-03-10T14:22:23Z INFO chunk=2 size=4.1MB 2026-03-10T14:22:29Z INFO chunk=3 size=2.9MB 2026-03-10T14:22:29Z ERROR upload failed status=403 url=https://s3.redwood-private/upload/... request_id=rq_7fc2b1a3 2026-03-10T14:22:29Z ERROR aborting bundle generation ``` kevin-ops: Thanks — that request_id helps. Does the 403 happen immediately on the PUT, or after some bytes stream? any proxy between collector and S3? elena-customer: It fails immediately after the 3rd chunk PUT returns 403. We have an outbound proxy but rules are plain HTTP passthrough. No WAF that we know of. maria-support: Can you run a curl reproduction against the presign URL for the failing chunk? We need a minimal repro to rule out client-side checksum mismatch or CRLF issues. Example (replace and ): ```bash curl -v -X PUT "" \\ -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" \\ --data-binary @chunk3.bin -o /tmp/curl-put.out 2>&1 | sed -n '1,120p' ``` maria-support: Also please attach the collector debug bundle (if it partially uploaded, we can still fetch logs) — if the presign is invalid we'll coordinate a fallback SFTP endpoint. elena-customer: Ran curl, response shows 403 with XML body: ``` AccessDenied Request has expired rq_7fc2b1a3 ``` anthony-sre: interesting — message says expired. Are your server clocks skewed? presigned URLs expire based on time. Can you paste `date -u` from the host that ran the collector? elena-customer: `date -u` returns `Tue Mar 10 14:22:30 UTC 2026` — seems fine. The presign lifetime we use is 60s in our config. kevin-ops: Two hypotheses: 1) chunk presigns are generated per-chunk with short TTL and upload took longer (network/multipart stalls), or 2) presign URL got mutated by proxy (CRLF or header trimming). Can you capture the raw curl verbose output (the `-v` we suggested) and paste the relevant lines? elena-customer: Raw curl shows: ``` > PUT /upload/abc?X-Amz-Algorithm=... HTTP/1.1 > Host: s3.redwood-private > User-Agent: curl/7.88.1 > Accept: */* > Content-Length: 3045120 > Expect: 100-continue < HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden < x-amz-request-id: rq_7fc2b1a3 < Content-Type: application/xml < Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:23:05 GMT ``` maria-support: That Date header on the response is a few seconds after your client time — not massive skew. Next step: can you generate a full debug bundle locally but tell the collector to not auto-upload, then tar and share it via a temporary presign we provide for diagnostics? Command: `./collector --generate-debug-bundle --no-upload --out ./bundle-raw` elena-customer: Done. I have `bundle-raw.tar.gz` locally (8.4MB). I can attempt an SFTP upload if you give creds, or you can provide a signed URL to our Redwood support staging S3. maria-support: I'll ask ops to create a temporary staging presign that stays valid 15 minutes. anthony-sre, can you create a presign for support-staging with tag support:diag and TTL 900s? Reference rq_7fc2b1a3. anthony-sre: creating presign now... debug-bot: presign-created url=https://staging-support.redwood/upload/tmp/aa11bb22 ttl=900 elena-customer: Uploading with SFTP fallback now: `sftp debug@staging.redwood << 'EOF' put bundle-raw.tar.gz EOF` elena-customer: SFTP succeeded. Path: `/incoming/bundles/1779123456-bundle-raw.tar.gz` kevin-ops: Got it. We'll pull the bundle and look for two things: collector's upload handshake logs (signedmanifest, chunk offsets) and the exact presign token generation code path. If we find a generator edgecase (e.g., TTL computed with local monotonic clock instead of UTC), we'll patch. maria-support: For future, if a chunk upload fails with 403 and XML shows "Request has expired", also try increasing `upload_chunk_timeout` and enabling `--omit-expect-continue` on collector (some proxies mishandle `Expect: 100-continue`). Example quick test: `curl -v -H "Expect:" --data-binary @chunk3.bin ""` elena-customer: Noted — Curl test without Expect also returned 403, but at least I can rule out `Expect` header. anthony-sre: We've pulled the bundle. Initial glance: collector v2.4.1 uses system clock for TTL and calculates chunk presigns with TTL-2s margin. There's one path where the margin is applied twice for slow uploads — reproducing now. kevin-ops: If that's the case, patch will be v2.4.2. For now we can suggest increasing presign_ttl in your collector config to 300s as workaround. Also if SFTP is acceptable, we'll continue to collect diagnostic bundles that way until patch is out. maria-support: Thanks for the quick repro and bundle — marking this as escalated to eng-runtime. We'll follow up with a private patch release and a support note. :thumbsup: elena-customer: Thanks all — SFTP workaround works. Please keep me posted on the patch ETA. maria-support: Will do. Thread will be updated when we have a release build and release notes.
